events.title: Emperor Valentinian II is found hanged at Vienne
events.description: The young western emperor was found dead in his residence in Gaul. Whether he was murdered by his general Arbogast or took his own life is still debated; civil war followed.
events.html: The young western emperor was found dead in his residence in Gaul. Whether he was murdered by his general Arbogast or took his own life is still debated; civil war followed.

events.title: Pope Innocent IV authorises torture by inquisitors
events.description: The bull Ad extirpanda permitted secular authorities to use torture to extract confessions from suspected heretics. It set a precedent for inquisitorial practice for centuries.
events.html: The bull Ad extirpanda permitted secular authorities to use torture to extract confessions from suspected heretics. It set a precedent for inquisitorial practice for centuries.

events.title: Bartholomew Gosnold names Cape Cod
events.description: English navigator Bartholomew Gosnold reached the Massachusetts peninsula and named it for the abundant cod his crew caught there. His voyage was an early English exploration of New England.
events.html: English navigator Bartholomew Gosnold reached the Massachusetts peninsula and named it for the abundant cod his crew caught there. His voyage was an early English exploration of New England.

events.title: Johannes Kepler confirms his third law of planetary motion
events.description: Kepler found that the square of a planet's orbital period is proportional to the cube of its distance from the Sun. Published in Harmonices Mundi, the law later underpinned Newton's theory of gravitation.
events.html: Kepler found that the square of a planet's orbital period is proportional to the cube of its distance from the Sun. Published in Harmonices Mundi, the law later underpinned Newton's theory of gravitation.

events.title: Nylon stockings go on sale across the United States
events.description: Shoppers bought some four million pairs of DuPont nylon stockings on the first day of nationwide sales. The synthetic fibre transformed fashion and was soon diverted to wartime parachutes.
events.html: Shoppers bought some four million pairs of DuPont nylon stockings on the first day of nationwide sales. The synthetic fibre transformed fashion and was soon diverted to wartime parachutes.

events.title: Britain tests its first thermonuclear weapon design
events.description: Operation Grapple saw a British bomb dropped near Malden Island in the Pacific. Its yield fell short of a true hydrogen bomb, but later tests that year succeeded and secured US nuclear cooperation.
